flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:a0ba.description: Ton quotidien chez Vitreco · Assembler et poser des éléments de verre préfabriqués, de miroirs ou de produits en verre aux murs, aux plafonds ou aux façades des bâtiment · Faire la fabrication de cadres métalliques pour l’installation des vitres · Préparer et poser des lanterneaux et des verrières sur divers types de bâtiments · Installer, ajuster, fabriquer et fixer des métaux d'architecture ou des produits de remplacement connexes dans des immeubles commerciaux ou industriels · Faire le remplacement des vitres ou des matériaux d’étanchéité endommagés · Lire et interpréter des plans et des spécifications techniques afin de déterminer le type et l'épaisseur des vitres et des cadres, la méthode d'installation et les matériaux requis Tes conditions de travail · Des semaines de travail de 40 heures en moyenne à l’année longue (8 heures par jour, 5 jours semaine). · Possibilité de faire des heures supplémentaires pendant des périodes de pointe. Ceci peut varier d’un contrat à l’autre. · La sécurité est la priorité absolue chez Vitreco-Flynn. Les vitriers reçoivent une formation exhaustive et nous leur fournissons du matériel à la fine pointe de la technologie afin qu’ils puissent travailler dans un environnement sain et sécuritaire. · Opportunités de croissance et de développement de carrière · Travail autant à l’intérieur qu’à l’extérieur, seul ou avec une équipe solide de vitriers ou avec d’autres corps de métiers. Ce que nous recherchons · Niveau de scolarité minimal secondaire 4 · Nous offrons la formation et le soutient pour ceux voulant faire leurs 150 heures afin de devenir apprenti vitrier · Des gens intéressés à travailler en vitrage et qui aiment le travail d’équipe · Des personnes qui aiment le travail physique, sont à l’aise en hauteur et à manipuler des vitres lourdes. · Carte ASP construction et cartes de compétences (un atout) #LI-NT1

foundryforgood-foundry-for-good:ashbyhq:.title: Video Specialist (Agency)
foundryforgood-foundry-for-good:ashbyhq:.description: Be Part of a Mission-Driven Team At Foundry for Good, we don’t just build businesses—we build businesses that do good. Across our family of brands, we support nonprofits, trade associations, and mission-driven organizations with innovative software, impactful marketing strategies, and tools that empower positive change. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: - Stability & Growth: We’re 100% self-funded, with no outside investors or debt, meaning long-term stability and thoughtful growth. - People-First Culture: Our 95%+ employee retention rate reflects our commitment to competitive pay, respect, and career development. - Global Collaboration: Work with talented team members in the US and the Philippines who share your drive for excellence and impact. - Mission-Focused Work: Every role here supports organizations making the world a better place. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a difference, we’d love to hear from you! Watch Our "Meet the Team" Video https://vimeo.com/1059846216/d84c59a1e7?share=copy ROLE We're seeking a talented and versatile Video Specialist to create short- and long-form video for Nexus Marketing's clients. This is primarily an editing and video creation role — you'll turn raw footage into polished, on-brand videos across formats, from social cutdowns and ads to webinars, interviews, testimonials, and educational content. A key part of the role is helping clients capture great footage from home. Since this is a remote, Philippines-based position, you won't be running on-site shoots — instead, you'll write recording setup guides, run remote recording sessions when needed, and direct clients over video to make sure the footage comes in at a high quality. Ideally, much of this runs independently with light coordination. This is an ideal role for an early-to-mid-career video editor with a couple of years of experience who takes pride in craft, works efficiently across multiple projects, and is comfortable interacting with clients directly. You'll join client calls and present your work, while account managers own the day-to-day relationships. RESPONSIBILITIES - Edit and produce short- and long-form video for clients, including social videos, ads, webinars, interviews, testimonials, and educational content - Work with clients to capture high-quality live footage remotely — writing setup guides, running remote recording sessions, and directing as needed - Create polished, on-brand videos from raw footage and existing assets - Add motion graphics, lower thirds, kinetic text, and branded elements to enhance videos - Handle audio cleanup, color correction, captioning/subtitles, and other post-production essentials - Edit and package webinar content for client use - Design or assist with thumbnails and supporting graphics - Manage multiple video projects and deadlines across several client accounts simultaneously - Join client calls to present work, gather direction, and guide recording when needed - Incorporate feedback quickly and accurately through revision cycles - Maintain organized, well-labeled project files and asset libraries SETUP - This is a work-from-home setup - Target of 42.5 billable hours per week This role follows a consistent daily rhythm that aligns with US Eastern business hours while giving you time for rest, personal tasks, and balance throughout your day. Here’s what a typical day looks like: - Start your day with a 4.5-hour work block: 9:30am–2:00pm (PHT) - Enjoy your afternoon free: 2:00pm–8:00pm (PHT) - Finish your workday with another 4.5-hour block: 8:00pm–12:30am (PHT) - Sleep/rest: 12:30am–9:30am (PHT) This structure offers a long midday break while supporting strong collaboration with US-based teams during their business hours. - Work-from-home setup [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/4802dda9-c742-4abd-893c-f4d51c51e50e/44d12927-ed39-4f53-b518-b616cab2c1cc/Split.png] Note: All of these times would shift 1 hour later when the time difference switches to 13

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:0dc71f50-e2f.title: GTM Automation Engineer, Outbound Marketing
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:0dc71f50-e2f.description: About Wing Wing is one of the world’s largest virtual talent companies, venture-backed and based in San Francisco. Leveraging our global scale, millions of applicants, and deep operational expertise, we’re now building next-generation AI and automation products. Across both sides of our business, we help companies automate workflows, scale revenue, and unlock world-class global talent. As part of this evolution, we are building a high-scale outbound engine to reach SMBs and mid-market companies at scale. This requires a new kind of role - one that blends engineering, automation, experiment velocity, and GTM execution. About the Role We are hiring a full-time GTM Automation Engineer to architect, automate, and optimize our outbound growth systems. This is a hybrid role combining Clay automation expertise, light engineering, outbound infrastructure, experimentation, and crisp copywriting. You will build and maintain the machine behind our outbound engine: Clay workflows, enrichment pipelines, domain infrastructure, multi-tool integrations, personalization systems, and data dashboards. You will run high-velocity experiments, write conversion-focused outbound copy, troubleshoot deliverability, and scale sending volume across hundreds of thousands of leads. You will work closely with our marketing, product, and sales teams - but you will own your domain with a high degree of autonomy. The systems you build will directly drive pipeline, revenue, and go-to-market strategy. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role that sits at the intersection of engineering and growth. The impact you make here will be massive. Responsibilities You will own the entire outbound automation machine, including: 1. Clay Workflows & Lead Infrastructure - Build advanced Clay workflows for scraping, enrichment, verification, scoring, routing, and personalization - Use APIs, webhooks, and custom code steps to automate data pipelines - Create ICP logic, trigger systems, and multi-step lead flows 2. Multi-Domain Email Infrastructure, Deliverability, Verification - Set up hundreds, up to thousands of domains, warming, DNS, DMARC, DKIM, SPF - Build scalable campaign systems in Instantly using Apollo data - Know the ins and outs of email verification: LeadMagic, BounceBan, and more - Maintain deliverability and sending health across all domains - Implement verification, cleansing, and bounce prevention 3. Experiments & Optimization - Ship several outbound experiments per week, measure results - Test variations of copy, subject lines, offers, personas - Build dashboards to track open → reply → meeting → revenue - Identify bottlenecks and improve system performance continuously 4. Copywriting & Messaging - Write clear outbound emails and short-form sequences - Use Clay’s AI rewriting + dynamic variables for deep personalization - Create persona-based messaging frameworks 5. Data & Engineering Tasks - Write small scripts (Python, JavaScript) when needed - Integrate tools through API calls and workflows - Clean, transform, and normalize data - Maintain accurate metrics and reporting Outcomes You Will Be Accountable For Scaling outbound sending volume from 5k → 50k → 250k+ emails/month Improving reply rates and meeting-booked rates through experimentation Reducing cost per qualified meeting Building a predictable outbound funnel that feeds Sales every day Ensuring strong deliverability across all domains and systems Automating manual steps so the outbound engine becomes self-sustaining Requirements Must-Have - Expert-level Clay experience (advanced formulas, automations, integrations) - Strong experience with Apollo and Instantly - Ability to write clean, concise outbound copy in English - Experience setting up email domains, DNS, verification, warming - Ability to write scripts with Python/JS - Strong data skills (normalization, dedupe, cleansing, schema design) - Experience running large-scale outbound campaigns - Strong analytical and experimentation mindset -

jobgether-jobgether:lever:58729d9f-80a6-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:58729d9f-80a6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Ireland. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:cdf5fd69-ea8.title: Sr. Product Designer - HER
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:cdf5fd69-ea8.description: Know where you belong! Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire. When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week. HER is the world’s largest community for lesbian, bisexual, and queer people. We’re a global, subscription-based consumer product serving millions of LGBTQIA+ users across 55+ countries — helping people connect, date, and build community in ways that feel authentic, affirming, and fun. HER is part of Match Group, the global leader in dating products, and sits within Match’s Affinity portfolio alongside other identity-led platforms. This gives us the best of both worlds: the scale, insight, and infrastructure of a global organization, with the autonomy, speed, and cultural focus of a small, mission-driven team. Design at HER is not decorative. It’s a core driver of differentiation, growth, and revenue — and a critical way we show up for our community. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of key product experiences across our iOS and Android apps (and occasionally web). This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and influence. Your primary focus will be creating distinctive, sapphic-first experiences that clearly differentiate HER in the dating market — while directly supporting rapid active user growth and a strong focus on revenue performance. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Leadership to shape what we build, why we build it, and how it performs in the real world.
responsibilities: End-to-End Product Design
Own design for complex product areas from discovery through launch and iteration, including both engagement and revenue-focused designs
Translate ambiguous, high-impact problems into clear user journeys, flows, and interfaces
Balance user experience, speed of execution, and business impact
Sapphic Differentiation & Experience Design
Design experiences that feel unmistakably HER — rooted in sapphic culture, joy, intimacy, and community
Push beyond generic dating patterns to create features users can’t get elsewhere
Ensure HER’s product experience remains emotionally resonant, culturally specific, and market-differentiated
Apply and evolve HER’s design system and brand expression
Experimentation & Measurement
Design experiments and A/B tests in collaboration with Product, Engineering, and DataIterate based on performance data and qualitative insight
Use learning from experiments to inform future design decisions
Prototyping & Validation
Create prototypes at varying levels of fidelity to explore, align, and validate ideas
Support regular user testing to de-risk solutions before build
Clearly communicate design intent and rationale to cross-functional partners
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with Product Managers to shape roadmaps and scope work
Partner with Engineering to ship high-quality experiences efficiently
Present work confidently to leadership and incorporate feedback without losing clarity or direction

pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:0c3aca7d-12dc-415.description: Location: San Francisco Bay area, hybrid role (2x/ week in downtown SF office) About Brico: Brico is building the future of licensing compliance. Think Turbotax but for licensing. Our mission is to enable innovation and increase access in the financial services space by removing the first barrier to entry - Licenses. As a fast-growing, customer-loved, VC backed start-up, we offer a dynamic work environment, where creativity and initiative are at the heart of every project. Joining Brico means becoming part of an early founding team dedicated to making licensing & compliance cheaper, faster and more joyful. About the role: We are seeking an entrepreneurial full-stack Software Engineer with the ability to move back and forth between front-end and back-end work. This role is ideal for someone who sees a problem and thinks about 10 ways to solve it, instead of thinking, “this is how it's been done for years”. We are looking for someone who lights up at the thought of automating the traditionally “non automatable” and delivering customer delight. Our ideal candidate should have high agency and be used to shipping high quality output at high velocity. This role is ideal for someone who wants to turbocharge their career and be part of an early founding team. Key Responsibilities: - Design, develop, and maintain high-quality web applications with a focus on user experience - Architect, design, develop, and maintain high-quality backend systems that support our licensing platform. - Work with 3rd party LLMs to integrate intelligent features and improve product functionality - Contribute to the overall system architecture and influence development processes to drive engineering excellence. - Conduct code reviews, implement testing protocols, and ensure high-quality software delivery. - Stay at the forefront of industry trends, technologies, and best practices, actively contributing to our knowledge-sharing culture. What we are looking for: Must have - 6-8 years of experience in full stack software development - Mastery of backend & frontend frameworks and languages such as Node.js, Python, React, Django or similar - Proficient with cloud-based infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and microservices architecture. - Expertise in version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines. - Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. - Strong communication skills - Track record of shipping high-quality projects in a customer-facing environment Nice to have - Strong desire to learn and integrate AI-driven features into products - B2B high-growth SaaS company experience What We Offer: - Impact: Directly influence the development and success of products that allows Brico to create a category defining company - Innovation: Work on cutting-edge technologies and AI-driven solutions in a forward-thinking environment. - Growth: Enjoy accelerated career growth in a rapidly scaling company. - Culture: Thrive in a supportive, collaborative, and innovative work culture. - Compensation: Competitive salary & equity - Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package, including 401K accounts, health, dental, and vision insurance.

Position Highlights Competitive salary & sign-on No Call - No Weekends – No Holidays Great coverage – Easy to take time away Quick easy cases Excellent culture Great location What You'll Do Provide anesthesia care for outpatient procedures Conduct pre-anesthesia evaluations and patient assessments Manage airway and anesthesia administration Monitor patients throughout procedures and recovery Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and support staff Maintain compliance with clinical and safety standards What We Offer Comprehensive benefits package Stable, respected practice Supportive team culture Strong operational support through The Specialty Alliance Competitive compensation with comprehensive benefits Autonomous practice environment within a respected, physician‑led organization Advanced clinical resources , including cutting‑edge diagnostics Stable, long‑standing practice with 25+ years of excellence Qualifications CRNA Eligible state license Excellent communication skills The Specialty Alliance - Powering the future of physician-led, multi-specialty care. Uniting and empowering the nation’s leading physician-led gastroenterology and urology practices through an exclusive alliance built for clinical excellence, growth, and exceptional patient care. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com . The Specialty Alliance Corporate Headquarters, 550 Reserve St., Suite 550, Southlake, TX 76092, USA The Specialty Alliance | GI Alliance | Urology Alliance
